title: Distributed Symmetry Breaking on Hyperbolic Random Graphs
summary: Real-world networks like the internet share patterns like a power law degree distribution and a high clustering coefficient. Many of these properties are captured by the generative model of hyperbolic random graphs (HRGs), which provides a theoretical framework for studying such networks. Motivated by the observation that several algorithms perform better on real-world networks than their worst-case guarantees suggest, we design and analyse distributed algorithms under the assumption that the input graph is an HRG.
